findings.highlight: Shut up! I'm treating your wounds, so hold still!"
findings.evidenceJa: 少しは大人しくしてなさいっての。
findings.governingReading: Her same speech continues through telling him to raise his right hand and applying medicine, with the closing source bracket after that continuation.
findings.explanation: Rin’s treatment utterance closes early and the follow-up is unquoted.

findings.highlight: it's useful, so I won't question it too much.
findings.evidenceJa: 便利だからあえて追及しなかったけど
findings.governingReading: しなかった states why she deliberately held back before, but it is now becoming creepy enough to raise the question.
findings.explanation: Rin’s prior deliberate non-investigation becomes a future intention not to question.

findings.governingReading: Rin dismisses Saber’s but and asserts her sole-explanation hypothesis.
findings.explanation: No buts becomes the malformed not buts.

findings.highlight: as long you obtain the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯さえ手に入れれば
findings.governingReading: The conditional remaining-in-world theory is one complete Rin speech utterance.
findings.explanation: The as-long-as clause loses as and the utterance closes with a single quote.

findings.highlight: I don't who the heck that guy is
findings.evidenceJa: あいつが何者なのかは判らない
findings.governingReading: 判らない states that he does not know the man’s identity.

findings.highlight: How did I figure that out?
findings.evidenceJa: なんだってそんな結論に達するんだ。
findings.governingReading: He has just rejected their conclusion and asks why they reached it; only63 later wonders why he himself knows the weapons are real.
findings.explanation: Questioning Rin/Saber’s fake-weapon conclusion becomes questioning his own genuine-weapon insight.

findings.highlight: fake Noble Phantasms wouldn't have harmed Caster.
findings.evidenceJa: 偽物の宝具でキャスターの魔術を貫通できるワケない
findings.governingReading: His rationale specifically concerns getting through her magical defense, not whether an ordinary fake could injure an exposed person.
findings.explanation: Piercing Caster’s magecraft becomes merely harming her.

findings.evidenceJa: むしろ他のが偽物っぽい
findings.governingReading: He contrasts the impression of these weapons with the others and62 expressly maintains that Lancer’s spear is also genuine.
findings.explanation: Other weapons looking comparatively more fake becomes all other weapons looking fake.

findings.highlight: we should think of our next moves.
findings.governingReading: Rin shifts from his unknown identity to his purpose, leading directly to Grail/romantic motive teasing.
findings.explanation: The next question being the man’s purpose becomes planning the group’s next moves.

findings.highlight: I don't think Tohsaka has it wrong.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の言い方は微妙に間違っていると思うが
findings.governingReading: Shirou finds Rin's description slightly off, accepts that Gilgamesh is fixated on Saber, then sharpens that into treating her as property.
findings.explanation: Shirou's mild disagreement with Rin's romantic description becomes agreement. His stronger conclusion that Gilgamesh sees Saber as property remains explicit.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂はセイバーとそういう話が出来て嬉しいらしく
findings.governingReading: Rin seems pleased to have this kind of conversation with Saber.
findings.explanation: The named singular subject takes look.

findings.highlight: find a way to change now, then return to the past from here!
findings.evidenceJa: 昔じゃなくて今から取り戻す方法を取れ
findings.governingReading: He opposes going back to redo history and urges a way of recovering her own life from the present.
findings.explanation: Recovering what was lost starting now gains an instruction to return to the past afterward.

findings.highlight: he could have been involved in a Holy Grail War.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争に関わっていない筈がない。
findings.governingReading: Given magehood and long residence, Shirou reasons that non-involvement is impossible.
findings.explanation: The claim that Kiritsugu could not have avoided involvement becomes possible involvement.

findings.highlight: not typically summoned as a Servant consecutively.
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ英霊がサーヴァントとして召喚される事もない。
findings.governingReading: 通常 governs Saber’s general explanation of ordinary spirit memory and repeat summoning; the source does not restrict repeats to adjacent wars.
findings.explanation: The ordinary no-repeat-summoning rule gains a consecutive-only limitation.

findings.highlight: you have witnessed my past in my dreams
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方が私の過去を夢見たように
findings.governingReading: 貴方 is the subject of dreaming her past, parallel to her seeing his past.
findings.explanation: Shirou dreaming Saber’s past becomes seeing it in Saber’s dreams.

findings.highlight: He acted purely out of self-interest
findings.evidenceJa: 己が目的にしか興味はなく
findings.governingReading: 己が目的 fixes attention on his chosen end; the speaker says at107 she does not know what he believed in or what drove him.
findings.explanation: Exclusive interest in his own objective becomes acting for personal benefit.

findings.evidenceJa: ほんとうにバカみたいに子供だった。
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s remembered man was absurdly childlike, qualifying the adult/parent role through innocence and idealism rather than simply affection.
findings.explanation: The adoptive Kiritsugu’s almost foolish childishness becomes comparative warmth.
